contract: Expandable role library and task/department views; inspectable role contracts explicitly marked not evaluated. See docs/design-direction.md and docs/role-library-validation.md.

accessibility.evidence: Native buttons and labelled fields support role selection, forms, department filters and playbook details. Added agents focus their task assignment. Selected agents retain pressed state. Scoped review, not a full audit.

responsive.evidence: Tasks, Observatory and Role library fit 1280, 1024, 390 and 320 widths. Expanded desktop and mobile playbooks inspected in light/dark appearances.

loading.reason: No asynchronous agent requests or provider connections exist.

empty.evidence: No matching role search and empty team department show explicit empty states.

error.evidence: Duplicate role names and whitespace-only task assignments are rejected with feedback; input HTML/script strings display literally.

partial.evidence: Custom roles explicitly disclose that they lack a reviewed workflow and evaluation cases.

success.evidence: All 22 built-ins were added, yielding 26 independent sample agents; separate task assignment, dynamic departments, multi-row figure selection, removal and playbook links worked without page errors.

permission.evidence: New agents remain Unassigned until a task is saved; saving queues sample state only. Tool labels and template status explicitly grant no real access or accuracy guarantee.

renderedEvidence.observation: Research templates with distinct equipment and readable playbook controls.
Multiple research specialists with independent tasks and a shared inspector.
Expanded research department with four instances in two rows.
Complete citation-checker contract and its unexecuted evaluation scenarios.
Readable narrow calendar playbook and explicit draft evaluation status.
